bullets.text: A private college officer died after a van hit her moped in Pallikaranai, and the office should monitor police action.
Hundreds of heavy vehicles smuggled minerals to Andhra using fake transit passes with government seals, and authorities must crack down.
Youth Manoj was injured in Chennai after his bike crashed into a getaway van while chasing cattle thieves, requiring police follow-up.
The AIADMK IT wing slammed a TVK MLA over a hospital night inspection, and the office should watch political media exchanges.
A netizen asked the minister to show similar speed in widening the Velachery-Tambaram road, and the office should note public road expectations.
GCC reviewed stormwater and canal works including Okkiyam Maduvu Canal widening for monsoon, and the office should oversee flood readiness.
Power supply will be hit in nearly 150 locations in parts like Pallavaram and IT corridor, so the office should alert residents.
Residents in Alandur zone complained about worms in drinking water and poor sanitation, and the office must urge immediate water utility action.
Out-of-state omni buses blocked a Gummidipoondi border checkpost causing traffic, and transport officials must resolve the permit dispute.
Collector Kavitha announced 134 free buses operating under the Vettri Payanam scheme in Thiruvallur, and the district team should track rollout.
The state launched a drone pilot training initiative at Sevvapet Govt Polytechnic, and the office should encourage local youth participation.
A global logistics firm opened a new tech centre in Chennai bringing 250 tech jobs, and the portfolio team should welcome investors.
Data center investments are surging as India's AI expansion depends on power and connectivity alignment, which the ministry should support.
The PanIIT AP Summit spotlighted DeepTech, AI, and Quantum Computing innovations, and the IT team should review emerging tech collaboration.
TVK chief Vijay campaigned in Madurantakam for candidate Maragatham Kumaravel, and the office should monitor political campaign developments.
Soumya Anbumani stated they will pressure the government to gradually reduce liquor shops, and the office should watch allied political stances.
GK Vasan stated TVK has high winning chances in byelections, and the office should note opposition remarks on electoral prospects.
Chief Minister Vijay launched the expanded free bus travel scheme benefiting over 84 lakh women daily, and the office should track reception.
Prime Minister Modi will inaugurate the Poonamallee-Vadapalani metro rail service on October 11, and officials should prepare for the event.
Prime Minister Modi will inaugurate the Ilaiyaraaja Music Research Centre at IIT Madras, and the office should coordinate protocol.
